content.title: 2026 Masters viewer's guide: Tee times for rounds 1 and 2, TV schedule, streaming
content.text: The 2026 Masters begins at Augusta National on April 9th. Michael Reaves/Getty Images The 2026 Masters, pro golf’s first major of the year, kicks off this week at Augusta National. Here is our complete 2026 Masters viewer’s guide for tournament week, including full Masters TV and streaming schedules and complete Masters tee times for Rounds 1 and 2.2026 Masters previewWe’ve finally made it. Major season kicks off this week with the Masters, and the world’s best golfers are in Augusta National, preparing to compete for the green jacket in front of millions of golf fans.Rory McIlroy comes into the week as the defending champion, having captured his first Masters title last year in dramatic fashion. His planned Masters Champions Dinner will set a high bar for the week. But once that is over, and Wednesday’s Masters Par 3 Contest is complete, McIlroy’s attention will turn to his title defense.A field of 90 other elite competitors will do everything they can to stop McIlroy from grabbing a second consecutive green jacket and sixth major title. That includes two-time champion and World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler, 2023 winner Jon Rahm and two-time major champ Bryson DeChambeau.Scheffler, Rahm and DeChambeau are all listed above McIlroy in the early Masters odds. ESPN will air the first and second rounds on Thursday and Friday, as well as coverage of Wednesday’s Masters Par 3 Contest.
